svg.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: POWER SHUFFLER - the hand-drawn v3 string and converters with the firmware control stack, as hierarchical sheets
Blocks: XS1 / XS2 = Shuffler_1.qsch / Shuffler_2.qsch (the drawn converters with their hall sensors), XC = Controller.qsch (the DLL, its sources,
and two PWM_Modulator.qsch comparator sheets). Right-click a block and open its schematic to look inside; every sheet carries its own notes.
Files that must sit next to this sheet: the four sub-sheets, HalfBridge_Driver.qsch, shuffler_ctrl_dll2.dll, ctrl_M2.txt (MSEL = 2); MyLibrary.lib via the library path.
Nodes: Out = PV1+ at the load, PV2P / PV3P = the INA239 string nodes, T1 / B1 and T2 / M2 / B2 = the converter rails behind the cable and copper inductors L23-L28.
Inside a block, name a current or node with QSPICE's bullet: I(V4•XS1), V(DA1•XC). The PARAMETERS column is the one place to edit.
Generated by Claude's outputs/build_power_shuffler_integrated.py from Buck Boost Full Bridge - v3.qsch (which it never writes); hand edits and the generator do not mix.
SHADE RAMPS V1 / V2 (Vtest, Vtest2: irradiance of module 2 in both strings), Vref and Vcc as drawn
REFERENCE STRING - the same modules and load, never gets a converter (comparison only)
PV STRING - X1-X3 Aiko modules, L1-L6 lead inductors, D4-D6 bypass diodes, L23-L28 cable / copper to the converters
LOAD I1 on Out (13 A ramp, VSAT 137.4 V)
SHUFFLER 1 - converter 1 on PV1+ / PV2+ / PV3+ (Shuffler_1.qsch)
SHUFFLER 2 - converter 2 on PV2+ / PV3+ / GND (Shuffler_2.qsch)
CONTROLLER - firmware control stack, DLL + PWM modulators (Controller.qsch)
PARAMETERS - edit values here (units: m = milli, u = micro, n = nano, p = pico)
PWM period: 5 u = 200 kHz (FSWP for the DLL follows 1/Tsw)
dead time cut from both edges of every FET pulse
logic level of the PWM into the gate drivers
controller enable time: open loop before it, closed loop after
duties before TEN (leg A / B of converter 1 / 2)
voltage-difference references (VM1-VM2, VM2-VM3) stepped at TSTEP
gain scale; 0.3 = firmware boot default (kscale in 7_Pi/pod/params.yaml)
0 = M compiled into the DLL (params.h), 1 = the 100 kHz S9i M, 2 = ctrl_M2.txt
0 = first-order IIR at FC Hz; 1..8 = moving average over that many control ticks
1 = firmware hall sampling (4 samples per PWM period), 0 = ideal average, 2 = old firmware
VM1 source (0 = INA239); VSTRP string-voltage option
* kept from the drawn v3 sheet
the 15 ms shade ramp of V1 / V2 starts inside the window
* .save keeps the .qraw small: every node of the measurements, add what you want to plot
.save V(Out) V(PV2P) V(PV3P) V(T1) V(B1) V(HS_A1) V(HS_B1) V(HS_A2) V(HS_B2) I(I1)
.save V(PWM_AH1) V(PWM_BH1) V(PWM_AH2) V(PWM_BH2) I(V4•XS1) I(V7•XS1) I(V5•XS2) I(V6•XS2)
.save V(DA1•XC) V(DB1•XC) V(DA2•XC) V(DB2•XC) V(STRESS•XC) V(BETA•XC) V(RV1•XC) V(RV2•XC)
* functions used inside the sub-sheets (a top-level .func is visible there)
TMCS1126 output: 1.65 V + gain * winding current
commanded duty: the DLL output when enabled, else the open-loop duty
top FET on while RAMP < D - Tdead/Tsw (all low at t = 0)
bottom FET on while D < RAMP < 1 - Tdead/Tsw
* quick check: .tran 1.5m with TEN=0.3m VSTEP2=1 TSTEP=0.8m (meas window 1.3m-1.5m) solves in about 30 s
* usual next move: .step param KSCALE list 0.3 1
MEASUREMENTS - settled window 18-20 ms of the 20 ms run
.meas tran vd1 AVG V(Out,PV2P)-V(PV2P,PV3P) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran vd2 AVG V(PV2P,PV3P)-V(PV3P) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran ic1 AVG I(V4•XS1)-I(V7•XS1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran ic2 AVG I(V5•XS2)-I(V6•XS2) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran ish1 AVG I(V4•XS1)+I(V7•XS1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran ish2 AVG I(V5•XS2)+I(V6•XS2) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran da1 AVG V(DA1•XC) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran db1 AVG V(DB1•XC) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran da2 AVG V(DA2•XC) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran db2 AVG V(DB2•XC) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran pout AVG I(I1)*V(Out) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran vout AVG V(Out) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran iout AVG I(I1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran hsa1 AVG V(HS_A1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran hsb1 AVG V(HS_B1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran hsa2 AVG V(HS_A2) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran hsb2 AVG V(HS_B2) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran pwmah1 AVG V(PWM_AH1) FROM 18m TO 20m
.meas tran pwmah2 AVG V(PWM_AH2) FROM 18m TO 20m
* vd1 / vd2: module voltage differences the controller nulls; ic / ish: circulating / shuffled
* inductor currents of each converter; da / db: commanded duties; pout / vout / iout: string power, voltage, current;
* stressmax: supervisor peak stress; hs*: hall outputs (1.65 V at zero current); pwmah*: top-FET PWM average
